message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration portrays a man from the chest up against a white tiled background. He wears a dark, long-sleeved, collared button-down shirt under a white apron smeared with reddish stains. He holds a large meat cleaver horizontally with both hands. His face is fair with short dark hair, looking directly forward. Behind him, two skinned animal carcasses hang from metal hooks and chains. The carcasses are pale with reddish muscular tissue visible.

Bold black letters spelling "TEMPO" span the upper section. Above these are white phrases: "KEMESRAAN AHOK DAN PARTAI GOLKAR" and "SETORAN BUPATI UNTUK POLISI". On the apron, large black text reads "PENGGEDE DI BALIK IMPOR DAGING," followed by smaller text: "Gagal menurunkan harga daging, pemerintah menambah kuota impor. Mengapa Badan Intelijen Negara sampai ikut campur?"

A red vertical banner borders the left side. The lower left corner includes "27 JUNI-3 JULI 2016," price, website, and a barcode. The bottom right identifies the man as "Menteri Perdagangan Thomas Lembong."
